scope: One symbolic draft layer in one invocation; source-level correspondence is conditional, not runtime tensor alias or a whole-model graph.
limitations: B::kv_precompute is an enclosing aggregate of the K fragment; excluded from combination connectivity to avoid hierarchical double counting, but retained as an external reference.
All slot mappings refer to the same layer-group selection, not aggregate equality across groups or three layer caches.
View edges are not operators, not established zero-copy, and not proof of device stream readiness.
Source branches and tensors may not match historical runtime.
